paper.title: High-LET Carbon and Iron Ions Elicit a Prolonged and Amplified p53 Signaling and Inflammatory Response Compared to low-LET X-Rays in Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells

experimental_design.biological_system: isolated human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs)
radiation_arms: Iron ions (1 GeV/n, 155 keV/um @ GSI SIS)
experimental_design.platform: Affymetrix GeneChip Human Gene 1.0 ST Array (HuGene-1_0-st-v1)
experimental_design.validation: qRT-PCR (PCNA, GADD45A, RPS27L, ASTN2, NDUFAF6, FDXR, MAMDC4) + gH2AX foci

E-MTAB-3463.title: Transcriptional response of PBMCs to ionising radiation (X-rays)

E-MTAB-5761.title: Transcriptional response of PBMCs to high-LET carbon and iron ions

smoke_test.finding: All 6 sampled CELs (1 per condition) are valid Affymetrix Calvin v1 (AGCC) files, array_type=HuGene-1_0-st-v1. Same array design across X-ray and heavy-ion experiments. Raw payload is real, publicly served, and consistent with paper's Materials and Methods.

feasibility.rationale: Both raw-data accessions are live on ArrayExpress/BioStudies (no auth, no paid endpoints). 76 CELs total ~830 MB. Same single-platform design (HuGene 1.0 ST) across all 76 arrays makes joint RMA + limma + Enrichr-style enrichment a textbook Bioconductor workflow. Smoke test confirmed AGCC format. Supplementary tables (ST1, ST5, ST6) referenced in HTML but not directly URL-extractable from Frontiers responsive page; available via the supplementary-material anchor on the article page if needed for hard cross-check of DE/signature gene lists.
blockers_for_full_replication: Heavy compute (RMA on 76 CELs + limma + RRHO) should NOT run on CherryRd. Run on uicgpu (or any box with R + Bioconductor: oligo, limma, pd.hugene.1.0.st.v1, enrichR).

Supplementary Tables 1/5/6 (primer list, full DE gene lists, GO terms) not auto-downloaded here. They are linked from the Frontiers article supplementary-material section; harvest with a browser tool if needed for hard QC against published DE gene tables.

qa_recommendation.justification: Both raw microarray data accessions (E-MTAB-3463, E-MTAB-5761) are live, fully open, and cover the exact comparisons in the paper (X-ray vs carbon vs iron at matched 1 Gy / 8 h on PBMCs, with sham controls). Same array platform across both experiments. Smoke test PASS. This belongs in block A, not B.
